dental-exams.name: Dental Exams
dental-exams.shortDescription: Comprehensive check-ups to maintain your oral health.
dental-exams.longDescription: Regular dental exams are crucial for preventing and detecting problems early. We conduct thorough examinations, including checks for cavities, gum disease, and other oral health issues, to keep your smile healthy.

fillings.name: Fillings
fillings.shortDescription: Durable fillings to restore teeth affected by decay.
fillings.longDescription: We use modern, tooth-colored composite materials to fill cavities, restoring the strength and appearance of your teeth. The procedure is quick, comfortable, and helps prevent further decay.

crownings.name: Crownings
crownings.shortDescription: Custom crowns to protect and restore damaged teeth.
crownings.longDescription: A dental crown is a cap placed over a damaged tooth to restore its shape, size, strength, and appearance. We offer high-quality crowns that look and feel natural, protecting your tooth for years to come.

bridges.name: Bridges
bridges.shortDescription: Dental bridges to replace one or more missing teeth.
bridges.longDescription: A dental bridge "bridges" the gap created by one or more missing teeth. It consists of two or more crowns for the teeth on either side of the gap and a false tooth/teeth in between, restoring both function and aesthetics.

anterior-root-canals.name: Anterior Root Canals
anterior-root-canals.shortDescription: Specialized root canal treatment for front teeth.
anterior-root-canals.longDescription: We perform gentle and effective root canal therapy on anterior (front) teeth to save them from infection or decay. Our focus is on relieving pain and preserving your natural smile.

tooth-extraction.name: Tooth Extraction
tooth-extraction.shortDescription: Safe and comfortable tooth removal when necessary.
tooth-extraction.longDescription: While we always aim to save natural teeth, sometimes an extraction is necessary for your overall oral health. We ensure the procedure is as comfortable and stress-free as possible.

oral-implants.name: Oral Implants
oral-implants.shortDescription: A permanent solution for replacing missing teeth.
oral-implants.longDescription: Oral implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. They provide a strong foundation for fixed or removable replacement teeth that are made to match your natural teeth, ensuring durability and a natural look.

scaling.name: Scaling
scaling.shortDescription: Professional deep cleaning to remove plaque and tartar.
scaling.longDescription: Scaling is a deep cleaning procedure that goes below the gumline to remove built-up plaque and tartar. It's a key treatment for preventing and managing gum disease and keeping your gums healthy.

dentures.name: Denture
dentures.shortDescription: Custom-made dentures to restore your smile and function.
dentures.longDescription: We provide comfortable, natural-looking full and partial dentures to replace missing teeth, helping you to eat, speak, and smile with confidence again.
